timing.interpolation: piecewise quintic; collision sampled at <=2ms plus edge subdivision

scene.unknown_space_policy: unobserved; default planning checks detected obstacles only, not proof of free space

right_zone.kinematics: original URDF, saved joint coordinates; identical to safe_zone.geometry.Model
right_zone.membership: recomputed convex hull; signed plane distance <= buffer_m + 1e-9

model.joint_coordinates: encoder_to_joint; corrections embedded in joint origins
model.joint_limits_coordinate_rule: q_model = q_saved + offset; saved limits = original model limits - offset
model.warning: STL bore assembly is checked mathematically. Mount plane/yaw and left stick require physical verification. Mesh mounting is provisional, not a certified physical model.
